declarations.description: Controlled or declarative reader surface for one semantic reader entry.

cssParts.description: Container for compact pane and host action controls.
cssParts.name: toolbar

slots.description: Host-owned actions placed after the Reader's built-in toolbar controls.
slots.name: toolbar-actions

members.name: sref
members.description: The reference the Reader starts from. Navigating inside the Reader doesn't change it.

members.name: data
members.description: Starting data for the Reader, which it accepts or rejects as a whole.

members.name: acquisition
members.description: Chooses how this element fetches data, instead of the default.

members.name: translationLanguage
members.description: Preferred translation language, for the starting text and texts you navigate to.

members.name: primaryVersionTitle
members.description: Exact title of the primary edition for the starting reference.

members.name: translationVersionTitle
members.description: Exact title of the translation edition for the starting reference.

members.name: hideAttributions
members.description: Hides the edition attribution on the source card.

members.name: activePane
members.description: Which pane the compact layout shows: `source` or `connections`.

members.name: chatExport
members.description: Shows a button that sends the selected reference to your page's chat, when one is selected.

members.name: contentLanguage
members.description: Which text the source card shows: `primary`, `translation` or `both`.

members.name: layout
members.description: How the source card arranges its two texts: `auto`, `stacked` or `side-by-side`.

members.name: sideOrder
members.description: Which text comes first side by side: `primary-first` or `translation-first`.

members.name: showConnectionPreviews
members.description: Whether connection previews are shown.

members.name: vocalizationMode
members.description: How much Hebrew vowel and cantillation marking to keep. `none` removes both.

members.name: status
members.description: Read-only loading state: `"empty"`, `"loading"`, `"ready"` or `"error"`.

members.name: currentEntryId
members.description: The ID of the current history entry.

members.name: selectedRef
members.description: The selected reference, when there is one.

members.name: rootLoading
members.description: Whether the starting text is still loading.

members.name: readerError
members.description: The error message, when the latest action failed.

members.name: canGoBack
members.description: Whether Back can return to an earlier entry.

members.name: historyTruncated
members.description: Whether older history entries were dropped to stay within the history limit.

events.name: sefaria-reader-connections-page-change
events.description: Asks to show a different connection page.

events.description: Requests connection previews. The element loads them unless a listener cancels the event.
